title: Because You Take Me to McDonald’s
description: After football practice, Kid-2 asks Grandma to bring him to his next practice. When she asks why he chose her, Kid-2 admits it’s because she always takes him to McDonald’s afterward.
alt: On a chilly autumn afternoon at a football field, Grandma walks beside Kid-2 while wearing a warm coat and scarf. Kid-2, still dressed in his football uniform and carrying his helmet, asks, 'Grandma, can you take me to my next practice?' Grandma asks, 'Why me?' Kid-2 cheerfully replies, 'Because you always take me to McDonald’s afterward.'
